topic: Implement and validate Apple-Silicon-native Mojo operator backends in a maintained fork of facebookresearch/pytorch3d, colocated with and parallel to PyTorch3D's existing CPU/CUDA implementations, then make ARIA-NBV PR #23 consume that fork so VIN-store generation, multi-step rollout-dataset generation, rendering, and pose generation run end-to-end natively on this Mac with minimal ARIA-side code.
rubric: PASS only when: (1) the owned PyTorch3D fork contains the necessary Mojo implementations beside the corresponding CPU/CUDA operator surfaces and exposes them through stable PyTorch3D Python interfaces; (2) ARIA-NBV pins/consumes the fork without repo-local duplicate Mojo kernels; (3) PR #23 installs/imports on arm64 macOS without CUDA-only runtime requirements for requested data-generation paths; (4) native Mac e2e runs produce a VIN store and multi-step rollout dataset with rendering and pose generation; (5) schema, reason-code, coordinate-frame, dtype/shape, CLI/config, scientific, and CPU/CUDA parity contracts are tested; (6) targeted tests/lint/build/adversarial QA pass; (7) before/after runtime and combined necessary implementation LOC are recorded, only positive verified experiments are kept, and unnecessary code is deleted; (8) independent code-reviewer APPROVE and architect CLEAR evidence exists.
